name: Call Home
source:
A young boy, troubled by his difficult family life, is struggling to keep a smile on his face. He needs an escape from the chaos. On his regular trip back home from school, he finds a phone number to call that claims to give exactly what he’s looking for: happiness. Without thinking, he dials it and is transported to a different...Planet? Dimension? Galaxy? He’s not really sure. Everything is perfect, until his guilt of abandoning his family sets in. He wants to go back, but no one in this new “perfect” world will let him.  

Call Home is an adventure based visual novel that challenges your perception on perfection and euphoria. Whether you end up truly happy or not is up to you.

[From [url=https://capseoule.itch.io/call-home] itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一个小男孩因家庭生活困难而苦恼，努力保持脸上的笑容。他需要逃离混乱。在他定期放学回家的路上，他找到了一个可以拨打的电话号码，该号码声称可以提供他所寻求的东西：幸福。他想都没想就拨通了电话，然后就被传送到了另一个……星球？方面？星系？他不太确定。一切都很完美，直到他对抛弃家人的愧疚感油然而生。他想回去，但在这个新的“完美”世界里没有人会让他这么做。

《Call Home》是一部基于冒险的视觉小说，挑战你对完美和欣快感的看法。最终你是否真正幸福取决于你自己。

[来自[url=https://capseoule.itch.io/call-home] itch.io[/url]]
